items.html: And therefore it is called the hidden secret, because this is very concealed. And therefore in this firmament there are stars, which are the souls, for there is their root, in the secret of the world that is to come; and likewise the twelve constellations, in the secret of the constellation, which spreads here; and likewise the sun and the moon and all those candles of light, their root is in it, in the upper world, in the secret of 'and he built it seven years.' And the matters are ancient.
